Review Speech to Note?

Reviewers describe Speech to Note as a practical, accurate speech-to-text tool that helps them capture ideas quickly and turn them into usable notes, summaries, emails, blog drafts, captions, and meeting records. The most repeated praise is strong transcription quality, fast summarization, flexible output formats, and an interface that feels easy to learn and use. People mention real value for meetings, study, journalism, client work, and even medical terminology. Support also stands out, with several users saying the team listens closely and ships improvements quickly.

results.content:

Review Talknotes?

Reviewers say Talknotes is a simple, useful way to turn messy voice notes into clear, usable text. Users repeatedly praise the transcription quality, including for mixed accents, and say it helps them capture ideas faster than typing, organize scattered thoughts, search old notes, and reshape rough speech into polished writing or even blog drafts. The main caveats are mostly requests and open questions rather than complaints: people want faster access on iPhone, more integrations, and proof it stays accurate in noisy meetings, with multiple speakers, or technical language.
